your passphrase decides WHICH wallet
your words open. a typo opens a

W_12_NOTE:
recommended. 128 bits of entropy,
easier to copy and verify.
W_24_NOTE:
256 bits of entropy, but longer to copy.
choose it to match an old wallet.
W_RAND_S:
three sources of randomness, mixed.

W_ENT_SRC1_NOTE: leaves, gravel, a shuffled deck. never a blank wall.
W_ENT_SRC2_NOTE: hardware noise, always running. nothing to aim.

W_ENT_MIX_B:
WHAT YOU POINT AT: the scene in front of the lens. never twice the same.
THE CHIP ITSELF: hardware noise, running since boot. nothing to aim.
YOUR OWN HANDS: the exact moment of each tap. no factory can guess it.
STILL NOT SURE: all three are made by this device. use DICE instead and you can check the result on any computer.
W_ENT_TAP_S: your timing is the part no manufacturer can guess.
W_ENT_TAP_NOTE: tap anywhere on the card. any rhythm.
W_ENT_FAIL_B: the sources did not combine, so nothing was saved. your funds are untouched.

W_DICE_UNEVEN_S: some faces came up far more than the rest
W_DICE_PATTERN_S: these run in order. a die does not.
W_DICE_W1_B: a shape someone can guess is a wallet someone can guess.
W_DICE_W2_B: your rolls are kept. roll on and the shape evens out.
W_DICE_HELP_B:
EACH FACE: how many times it came up. a die levels them out.
IN ORDER: 1 2 3 4 5 6 over and over is level and still not rolled.
YOUR CALL: this is a nudge, never a lock.
W_CARDS_NOTE: words you drew from paper cards. no machine randomness.
W_CARDS_S: you supply the words. the device only finds the last one.
W_CARDS_W1_B: cut the word list into cards, shuffle well, draw blind. type each drawn word here.
W_CARDS_W2_B: words from your head can be guessed. only a blind draw is random.
W_CKSUM_S: your last word is math, not chance.
W_CKSUM_W1_B: the numbers behind your words add up. the wallet accepts them.
W_CKSUM_W2_B: the sum breaks and the wallet says no. a typo can never hide.
W_CARDS_PICK_S: each of these completes your words. any one works.
W_WRITE_S: words + the same passphrase restore this wallet
W_PAPER_ONLY: paper only. never type or photograph.

W_VERIFY_S: type each word from your paper; the device only confirms

W_VOK_S: your written words match this wallet's recovery phrase
W_VOK_B:
keep it offline and private.
words + passphrase restore this wallet.
W_VOK_FP:

W_VBAD_S: as written, your paper would not bring this wallet back

W_VINTRO_S: prove your written words match this wallet's recovery phrase
W_VINTRO_W1_B: your paper brings this wallet back. one wrong word and it does not.

your coordinator built a bitcoin transaction: which coins to spend, where they go, and the fee. it has no signature yet, so the network will not accept it.

the full name is a partially signed bitcoin transaction, or PSBT. other wallets use the same word.

only your keys can sign it, and they only live here. so scanning brings you a transaction to read, and signing is a separate decision you make on the next screen.

INPUTS: coins this transaction spends.
OUTPUTS: every place it sends bitcoin.
CHANGE: the part returned to your own verified address.
TXID: the tracking ID used after broadcast.
FEE RATE: fee paid per unit of transaction size.
LOCKTIME: the earliest block it may confirm in.
DERIVATION PATH: the route from seed words to addresses.
DESCRIPTOR: a read only address map. it cannot spend.

one frame: a file, a SHA256 hash, a 24 word seed.
verify all three on any computer.
